name: atan_entry_3_off_by_one
why: one arctangent table entry is rounded the wrong way (20754 instead of 20753)

name: atan_entry_1_digits_swapped
why: a transcription error in the second table entry (77736 instead of 77376)

name: logical_shift_of_y
why: y is shifted logically, so negative y feeds a huge positive term into x

name: zero_residual_rotates_down
why: the direction test uses z > 0, so a zero residual angle rotates the wrong way

name: fold_on_sign_not_quadrant
why: the half-turn fold is chosen by the sign bit instead of quadrants 01 and 10

name: gain_constant_off_by_one
why: the CORDIC gain compensation K is truncated (39796) instead of rounded (39797)

name: z0_not_scaled
why: the 16-bit angle is sign-extended into z instead of scaled by 16 to 2^-20 turn units

name: cos_truncates_instead_of_rounding
why: cos_out drops the round-half-up offset and truncates

name: fifteen_iterations
why: the engine stops after fifteen micro-rotations and raises out_valid one edge early

name: y_update_sign_flipped
why: a positive residual rotates y the wrong way
